content.title: Defense Stocks Move Higher After Trump Calls for Huge Defense Budget
content.summary: U.S. defense companies rallied after President Trump called for a $1.5 trillion defense budget, more than $500 billion more than the Pentagon is expected to receive this fiscal year.  Trump said the increased budget was necessary “especially in these very troubled and dangerous times,” in a social-media post late Wednesday.  Shares of Northrop Grumman, Lockheed Martin and L3Harris jumped between 2.4% and 5.2%.
